question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It looks as if it might rain tonight as the sky is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **'overcast'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An** overcast **sky means clouds covering a large part of the sky.

 
 
• Example-The planes found the target obscured by overcast.
 
 
 
• Among the options, **'overcast'** is clearly the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Overjoyed **means being extremely happy.

 
 
• Example- All of them were **overjoyed** upon hearing the good news.
 
 
 
• **Overdue** means not having arrived, done, or happened by the expected time.
 
 
• Example- Your mid-term assignment is long **overdue.**
 
 
 
• **Oversized **means bigger than usual size.
 
 
• Example- **Oversized** clothes are making a huge comeback in the fashion industry.
